SD16.description: Supplementary Data 16: SMR results for GTEx v8 eQTLs significantly associated with endometriosis (overall or severe GWAS); standard SMR columns; one top SNP per gene-tissue-GWAS row.

Mortlock2023CB-46.notes: SMR top cis-eQTL rs2473290 (GTEx v8 Colon_Sigmoid) vs the overall endometriosis GWAS, from Supplementary Data 16. A1 is the effect allele for b_eQTL and b_GWAS; Freq is the A1 frequency. b_GWAS / b_eQTL reproduces the table's b_SMR.
